focus: Skill-advisor and deep-loop suites: vitest-only trees whose cost is installation, not assertions
noveltyJustification: 5 of 6 findings are fully new and 1 partially restates the file census with the install share added.
keyQuestions: Which test files under `.skilled/skills/*/runtime` are redundant, mirror the implementation, or re-assert framework behavior, and how long does each suite take?
Which overengineered test infrastructure (custom harnesses, serial lists, fixtures, helper layers) costs run time or maintenance beyond the coverage it adds?
ruledOut: Re-litigating CI caching to fix the install share

graphEvents.label: Which test infrastructure costs more than its coverage
The stress suite sits behind an env gate nobody set

label: Both trees are vitest-only: the advisor runtime holds 185 test files and the deep-loop runtime 174, so neither contributes to the node:test corpus and both run only through their own workflows.
Skill Advisor Stress Tests spends most of its 457 s mean on installation: five npm ci installs plus a build precede the first test, while its comment puts the tests at 0.5 and 2.7 minutes.

Deep-Loop Runtime Tests has the same shape at 472 s mean (four installs, a build, a drift check, then the suite), and its drift check is the one duplication that earns its place because it fails in seconds.
Child-process spawning is the real per-file cost: 31 of 185 advisor suites and 43 of 174 deep-loop suites spawn a process, so about one file in five pays startup per assertion.

fanout-run.vitest.ts is 6115 lines, the largest single test file in the repository and larger than the whole spec-tree test census; the only available cut is splitting it, which earlier phases already settled.

The stress suite is gated behind SPECKIT_RUN_STRESS and a second vitest config that nothing set, so two of its tests failed for months; merging it into the default run costs half a minute per advisor change and removes a silent-always-off path.

direction: Keeping the stress suite behind SPECKIT_RUN_STRESS and a separate config
reason: The gate is what let the suite rot unseen for months; a half-minute suite does not need an env switch.
